summary: Preserve static `super.prop` lookup, which starts at the superclass constructor object but uses the current constructor object as Receiver.

target.notes: Use JavaScript [[Get]]/[[Set]] with the superclass constructor object as lookup base and the current class-call receiver as Receiver.

caveats: C# static members have no dynamic receiver equivalent to JavaScript constructor-object `this`.
references: ECMAScript Super Calls and Super Property: https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-super-keyword

tests.name: static super getter receiver
tests.input: class A { static get x(){ return this.y; } } class B extends A { static y=5; static m(){ return super.x; } } console.log(B.m());

tests.name: edge: inherited caller changes receiver
tests.input: class A { static get x(){ return this.name; } } class B extends A { static m(){ return super.x; } } class C extends B {} console.log(C.m());
